customManagers.description: Renovate updates bun.lock with this Bun, so it moves with .bun-version.

packageRules.description: One pull request a week for the minor and patch updates of each ecosystem. Major updates get their own pull requests.
Generators own runner labels, job containers, and action inputs. Renovate may only move action pins, which come from .github/actions/pins.yml.

A Bun upgrade also moves the docs, the runtime-bundle builder image, and the pinned Bun license, so .bun-version, constraints.bun, engines.bun, and Bun's types wait together for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
The root workspace catalog is the only place the Effect version is written by hand. Upgrades need codegen and review, so they wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
@opentui/core 0.8.1+ native packages statically link LGPL FFmpeg. Stay on 0.8.0 until https://github.com/anomalyco/opentui/issues/2088 ships a video-free build.
